page_title: 6th Gen AMD EPYC Server CPUs Power the Agentic Data Center

sources.entry: 6th Gen AMD EPYC Server CPUs - The Zen 6 server family, so far a press release with no shipped part, pending shipment and a public run against Zen 5.

summary.title: 6th Gen AMD EPYC Server CPUs Power the Agentic Data Center
summary.one_liner: AMD's announcement of the EPYC 9006 Series server CPUs, a family of Zen 6 processors positioned for agentic AI, general-purpose and HPC workloads, with per-SKU roles and vendor-supplied comparison claims.
takeaways: AMD positions the EPYC 9006 Series around three CPU roles in agentic infrastructure: agent sandbox execution, AI host nodes feeding GPUs, and general-purpose servers.

The lineup includes SP7 (up to 256 cores/512 threads, up to 5GHz in high-frequency configs), SP8 (8 to 128 cores, low-power), 9006X SP7 (3x L3 cache per core, HPC focus), and LP (formerly 'Verano', LPDDR memory, AI host node).
AMD introduces 'Default CPU Power' as its new power reference in place of historical TDP, covering compute and I/O dies.

Efficiency and density claims (agents per watt, per dollar, per rack) are backed by footnotes that rely on estimates and theoretical workloads, so they are vendor-supplied and not independently measured on the page.
The page is a press/marketing announcement; it does not give shipping dates, benchmark results, or pricing for the parts.
summary.summary: This AMD newsroom post, published around Advancing AI 2026, introduces the EPYC 9006 Series server CPUs for agentic AI, cloud, general-purpose and HPC use. It describes a three-tier agentic data center model and maps four SKU families (SP7, SP8, 9006X SP7, and LP) to those roles, listing core counts, frequencies, cache and PCIe Gen 6 support. Most of the page is positioning, and the footnotes give comparisons against Intel Xeon, Nvidia Vera and AMD's own prior generation based on published TDPs, core counts and estimated agent capacity. Those comparisons are estimates under stated assumptions, and the page gives no independent measurements or ship dates.
